main_text.l: lium certaminum, & curarum beneuolentiam,
atque purum affectum vicissim accipere? Quia
prior adorauerat Pontifex Photium, prior
illius curam egerat, prior beneuolentiam
& purum affectum in Photium common-
strauerat, a Photio dignus habitus est &
veneratione & cura & affectu: Si non id
egisset, Photiana gratia, & affectu indi-
gnus iudicatus fuisset; & vixisset Romae in-
glorius, inhonorius, incuratus, neglectus.
Quis non videt impudentiam Photij? quis
non miratur Romanam inertiam, reliquorum
Praesulum dementiam? Et credam ipse simi-
lia in confessu publico Praesulum celebrata?
Et considera[?] Lector. Synodus ista co-
genda prorsus erat pro restitutione Photij
expulsi, vt sicuti confessu publico eiectus
fuerat, ita & publico decreto suo throno
redderetur, quod videbatur magis ipsi Pho-
tio honorificum, sic enim iniustitia sibi fa-
cta apertius omnibus patuisset. Et nihilo-
minus haec Synodus cogitur non pro illius
restitutione, sed contra illius rebelles, &

page.notes: The Greek paragraph is only partly legible on the scan, especially the first two lines and the middle of the paragraph. The Greek words marked [?] are best readings, and the wording of the passage is not certain. The Greek tail "ἐν" at the foot is the catchword, not part of the text. The Latin "considera" is doubtful: it could be "consldera" in print. The "E 4" signature is printed at the foot and is included in bottom_margin.
